about: Couplings (LIFE_SYSTEMS 3b, 4d, 4c): if a stock, need or belief is past a level, push a stress target or change how fast a need drops. Checked once per game hour. who: each (every person) or adults (age 18 and over). {p} is the person's id. need 'any' counts each of the person's needs below the level; a named need counts 0 or 1. perMatch multiplies the push by the number of matches. belief: what the person thinks a subject is worth (data/beliefs.json), never the truth. ifNoBeliefs: the condition used in a world built without beliefs (the L4 behaviour). All numbers are tuning.
